dispatch_recommendation: Retain reviewed 2GiB single-file exception only for the known three families; require five-trial semantic payload + all copied runtime inputs + raw/trace/impulse/duplicate outputs + enforced 256MiB aggregate auxiliary quota + 2GiB free reserve. Recheck under root GPU lock immediately before each model; a free-space snapshot is not a reservation. Existing staged copies already consuming disk may conservatively be counted again; do not omit newly copied assets. No additional collector expansion essential from this census.
budget_qualification: Known exact/source-shaped payloads and observed per-PID output shapes are recorded separately from a declared auxiliary quota. The review ledger field all_observer_total_bound_certified=true means conditional admission only if that quota is enforced; it is not a mathematical bound for arbitrary compiler/log/NCU output. Unknown auxiliary fields remain null. Directory totals spanning models or historical attempts are not per-profile budgets.
evidence_limits: Fresh SHA checks cover selected config/result/source metadata; artifact payload SHAs are frozen recorded values, while byte sizes were freshly stat-checked. No additional >1GiB file observed in listed manifests/directories/log paths, not a proof that all possible future unrecorded temporaries are absent. No hidden-output allowance was inferred from an empty search.
